description: Central fleet configuration - prevents scattered project folders

rules.oracle_awakening: Always check fleet_registry before creating new project directory
rules.memory_location: Store each oracle's memory under fleet_memory_root/{oracle_name}/
rules.project_isolation: Use fleet_root for all oracle contexts; never create $HOME/.claude/projects/{oracle-name}/
rules.env_variable: Export ORACLE_FLEET_REGISTRY with path to fleet-registry directory
